200.description:
The catalogue page of one M&S Heritage record by Preservica id (IO_<uuid> item or SO_<uuid> folder) or pasted record URL: title, object type (Item or Folder), parent folder ('In Folder'), breadcrumb, description, labelled metadata entries (e.g. Date, Reference Number), thumbnail URL, the record's page URL and, for items with a viewable asset, the viewer entity reference on mands.preservica.com. The asset viewer and the asset bytes need a token the site issues per page load and are not fetched. Unknown ids answer not_found (the site's 404 page).

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `breadcrumb` | object[] | The breadcrumb as rendered, root first; the site elides middle levels as '. . .' (id and url null), and the last entry is the record itself. |
| `description` | string |  |
| `id` | string |  |
| `kind` | string |  |
| `metadata` | object[] |  |
| `object_type` | string | The site's 'Object Type' label (Item or Folder); null when the page shows none. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `parent` | object | The 'In Folder' link; null when the record sits directly under the Browse Collections root. |
| `thumbnail_url` | string |  |
| `title` | string |  |
| `url` | string |  |
| `viewer_entity_ref` | string | entityRef of the embedded Preservica viewer (the uuid without the IO_ prefix) when the page embeds one; null otherwise (folders). |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

folder_id.description: SO_<uuid> structural object id, or a pasted folder page URL (/uncategorized/SO_<uuid>/ or /index.php?name=SO_<uuid>), or 'root' for the Browse Collections root. Omit for the root.

page.description:
1-based page of children (50 per page). A page past the last one answers not_found. The root has a single page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500; default 1.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
One page of the children of a folder (structural object) in the M&S Heritage collection hierarchy, from the folder's HTML page (/uncategorized/SO_<uuid>/?pg=N; 50 children per page), or the 21 top-level collections of the Browse Collections root (/archive) when folder_id is omitted. Returns the folder's own header metadata (title, object type, parent, breadcrumb, description, metadata entries such as Date and Reference Number; null for the root) and each child's id, kind (item or folder), title, description, date, page URL and thumbnail URL.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `children` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `date` | string |  |
| `description` | string |  |
| `id` | string |  |
| `kind` | string |  |
| `thumbnail_url` | string |  |
| `title` | string |  |
| `url` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description:
Find archive records (magazines, photographs, reports, adverts, catalogues) by keyword, or list everything of one file format or reference number; take the returned `id` to get_record or, for folders, to list_folder.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 provider_credit $0.0001 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

collection_id.description: Restrict to one top-level collection: a term of the `xip.top_level_so` facet (a uuid, with or without the SO_ prefix), e.g. 82e5314d-48d7-4fb9-bbf4-cf0878a6fc35 for Staff Magazines.

folder_id.description: Scope the search to one folder's hierarchy: an SO_<uuid> structural object id (from list_folder or a result item of kind folder), or a pasted folder page URL.

format.description: Restrict to one preservation file format: a term of the `xip.format_group_r_Preservation` facet, e.g. pdf, jpeg, mpeg-video.

page.description:
1-based result page (50 hits per page). A page past the last one answers not_found.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500; default 1.

query.description:
Keyword(s), as typed into the site's search box. May be empty when a filter (collection_id, format, reference_number or folder_id) is given.

Provider reference: default "".

reference_number.description: Archival reference number (Refno) filter, e.g. CR/D/3/2 or HO/3/2/2/2. The site matches loosely (parent and sibling references can appear); compare `metadata` Reference Number from get_record when exactness matters.

sort.description:
Result order: the site's relevance ranking, or title ascending / descending.

Provider reference: allowed values ["relevance", "title_asc", "title_desc"]; default "relevance".

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Keyword search of the M&S Heritage catalogue through the site's own AJAX search (admin-ajax.php, action pres_search_paged_posts). One page of up to 50 results (items and folders) with the Preservica id, title, description, date, page URL and thumbnail URL of each hit, plus the collection and file-format facets of the result set (terms with a non-zero count only). Optional narrowing by folder (folder_id, the search runs inside that folder's hierarchy), top-level collection (collection_id, a facet term), preservation file format (format, a facet term such as pdf or jpeg) and archival reference number (reference_number, the site's Refno field filter, a loose match). Sort by relevance (default) or title. `page_count` is the number of result pages the site links to; the total hit count is not part of the JSON answer.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `items` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `date` | string | The Date column as shown (free text such as '2000', 'Sep 1949-Nov 1949', 'see title'); null when the site renders none. |
| `description` | string | The Description column as shown; null when the site renders none. |
| `id` | string | Preservica entity id: IO_<uuid> for an information object (item), SO_<uuid> for a structural object (folder). |
| `kind` | string |  |
| `thumbnail_url` | string |  |
| `title` | string |  |
| `url` | string | The record's page on msheritage.access.preservica.com. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
